extracted.intended_audience: philanthropists, potential grantees, partners, and the general public interested in ClimateWorks Foundation
extracted.subtask_description: Organizational 'About' page describing ClimateWorks Foundation's mission, scope, expertise, financial status, and public-facing commitments. Useful for applicants and partners to understand priorities and institutional credentials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission: end the climate crisis by amplifying philanthropy
rubrics_metrics.description: ClimateWorks team is on a mission to end the climate crisis by amplifying the power of philanthropy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The foundation focuses grantmaking and strategy on accelerating climate progress; proposals and partnerships should align with the goal of meaningful climate mitigation/adaptation and leverage philanthropic funding for outsized impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Focus on accelerating climate progress and scaling solutions
rubrics_metrics.description: ClimateWorks is a catalyst for accelerating climate progress, driving bold solutions that benefit people and the planet; they create and scale transformative solutions across sectors and geographies, achieving faster, greater impact together.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Priority is given to initiatives that can be scaled and that operate across sectors/geographies. Emphasis on transformative, high-impact approaches rather than small, isolated interventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collaboration and convening funders and implementers
rubrics_metrics.description: We connect funders and implementing organizations worldwide to create and scale transformative solutions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects that involve multi-stakeholder collaboration, partnership-building, or that facilitate coordination among funders and implementers are aligned with ClimateWorks' operating model.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evidence-based, interdisciplinary expertise
rubrics_metrics.description: Staff bring expertise in climate science, strategic philanthropy, public policy, and social and economic development to assess the science, identify opportunities, and shape philanthropic initiatives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals and partnerships should demonstrate grounding in climate science and relevant policy/economic context; ClimateWorks values analytically informed strategies and interdisciplinary approaches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Global reach and multi-funder engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: Since 2008, ClimateWorks has granted over $2 billion to more than 850 grantees across 50 countries, working alongside 80 funders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preference or demonstrated experience with international work and engagement with multiple funders/partners may be relevant; the foundation operates at global scale.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organizational transparency and financial compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: ClimateWorks Foundation is a U.S.-based 501(c)(3) public charity that files an IRS Form 990 annually providing detailed information about the organization and finances; Forms 990 are linked on the site.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: As a compliance and transparency practice, ClimateWorks publishes financial filings; prospective partners/grantees can review these documents for organizational accountability and funding practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commitment to a thriving climate future (values/vision)
rubrics_metrics.description: ClimateWorks is driven by a vision of creating a thriving planet for all living beings for generations to come.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Initiatives that emphasize long-term ecological and social well-being, intergenerational equity, and broad societal benefits align with the foundation's stated values.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organizational credibility and recognition
rubrics_metrics.description: ClimateWorks Foundation received the Stars of STEM award from the Museum of Science in Boston in 2023.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: External recognition and awards are cited as markers of credibility; partners/grantees may note the foundation's standing and reputation when considering engagement.
